object_types.name: Student
object_types.definition: A person who enrolls in course offerings at the university.

source_references.excerpt: Students enroll in course offerings, not in courses directly.
Students have a student number.

object_types.name: Course
object_types.definition: A subject of study that can be offered in different semesters.

source_references.excerpt: A course offering is a specific course offered in a specific semester.
Courses have a course code, like CS101.

object_types.name: CourseOffering
object_types.definition: A specific instance of a course being taught in a specific semester by a specific instructor.

source_references.excerpt: A course offering is a specific course offered in a specific semester.
Offerings get an offering ID.

object_types.name: Instructor
object_types.definition: A person who teaches course offerings.

fact_types.name: Student enrolls in CourseOffering with LetterGrade

source_references.excerpt: Students enroll in course offerings, not in courses directly.
At the end of a semester, a student receives a letter grade for each course offering they were enrolled in. The grade is one of A, B, C, D, or F. A student gets at most one grade per offering.

ambiguities.description: Is enrollment (Student in CourseOffering, apart from the grade) tracked as its own concept prior to grading?
